name: alwrity
description: A comprehensive AI-first platform providing content strategy and planning, multimodal content generation, publishing, analytics, AI-powered SEO, and management of connected social accounts for digital marketing.

inputs.name: marketing_goals
inputs.description: Objectives or goals defined by the user for the marketing campaign.

inputs.name: content_parameters
inputs.description: Specifications for content generation including format, topic, tone, and length.

inputs.name: social_account_credentials
inputs.description: Authentication data to connect and manage user social media accounts.

inputs.name: analytics_data
inputs.description: Data collected from published content and social accounts for performance tracking.

inputs.name: seo_keywords
inputs.description: Keywords or phrases used as input to optimize content for search engines.

outputs.name: content_strategy_plan
outputs.description: AI-generated detailed plan for content creation and marketing roadmap.

outputs.name: generated_content
outputs.description: Text, images, videos, or other content formats produced for marketing purposes.

outputs.name: published_content_status
outputs.description: Status and metadata of content after being published on various platforms.

outputs.name: marketing_analytics_report
outputs.description: Insights and performance analytics derived from campaign data.

outputs.name: seo_optimization_suggestions
outputs.description: Recommendations to improve search engine ranking and visibility.

steps: Define marketing goals and campaign objectives
Generate AI-based content strategy and planning roadmap
Create multimodal marketing content based on strategy
Publish content across connected social media and digital platforms
Collect and analyze performance data from campaigns
Generate actionable SEO recommendations and refine strategies
Manage and adjust social account connections and content scheduling
use_cases: Automating digital marketing content creation and publication
Optimizing content for SEO with AI insights
Managing multiple social media accounts from a single platform
Tracking and analyzing marketing campaign effectiveness with AI analytics
patterns: Social media account integration and management

prompt_templates.name: content_strategy_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate a content strategy plan for the marketing goals: {marketing_goals}

prompt_templates.name: content_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Create {content_parameters.format} content about {content_parameters.topic} with a {content_parameters.tone} tone and {content_parameters.length} length.

prompt_templates.name: seo_optimization_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Provide SEO optimization suggestions based on these keywords: {seo_keywords}

prompt_templates.name: analytics_summary_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Summarize insights and performance from this campaign data: {analytics_data}
